description: Every fill (buy/sell execution) a wallet made in a time window, newest first, with totals: volume, realized PnL, fees and a per-coin breakdown. since/until accept Relative ("30m", "6h", "24h", "7d"), a date ("2026-10-01"), a date-time ("2026-10-01T12:00:00Z"), "now", or Unix ms. Default window: last 24h. Large orders split into many fills are merged by default.

address.description: Wallet address, 0x followed by 40 hex characters.

coin.description: Market name, any case: "BTC", "eth", "HYPE", "kPEPE", or a HIP-3 market such as "xyz:TSLA".

limit.description: How many rows to return (default 100, max 2000).

mergeSplitOrders.description: Merge pieces of one order into a single fill (default true).

since.description: Start of window. Relative ("30m", "6h", "24h", "7d"), a date ("2026-10-01"), a date-time ("2026-10-01T12:00:00Z"), "now", or Unix ms. Default "24h".

name: hydromancer_wallet_trades
title: Wallet trade history (fills)
